name: wechat-channels/v2/video-detail
description: Get the full detail of a WeChat Channels video: description, author, engagement counts and the media URL with decode key for download. Look up by object ID, export ID or share URL.

raw.title: Raw
raw.description: Optional, default True. True=raw response; False=simplified parsed structure (recommended for media download).

export_id.title: Export Id
export_id.description: Second priority, optional. `exportId` from search results (must start with `export/`). Search results often only carry `exportId` without a plain object_id — pass export_id directly in that case (it expires, use it soon).

object_id.title: Object Id
object_id.description: Highest priority, optional. Video objectId (numeric), e.g. `14941130915890399732`. Obtainable from the video `id` of `fetch_user_videos` / `fetch_collection_videos`.

share_url.title: Share Url
share_url.description: Last, optional. Channels share URL (`https://weixin.qq.com/sph/…`), e.g. `https://weixin.qq.com/sph/AH3sCoIPhH`. Used only when both object_id and export_id are empty.

object_nonce_id.title: Object Nonce Id
object_nonce_id.description: Optional. `feedNonceId` (numeric) from search results, pairs with the above to improve hit rate.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# WeChat Channels Video Detail API

Pass a Channels video `object_id`, `export_id` or share URL and get the video detail, including the `media` address and `decode_key` needed to download it.

## Use cases

- Download and archive Channels videos.
- Get full details for videos found in search.
- Track engagement on a specific video.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/wechat-channels/v2/video-detail" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"object_id": "15026240326408735234", "raw": false}'
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `raw` | boolean | No | Optional, default True. |
| `export_id` | string | No | Second priority, optional. |
| `object_id` | string | No | Highest priority, optional. |
| `share_url` | string | No | Last, optional. |
| `object_nonce_id` | string | No | Optional. |

## Notes

- Priority when several inputs are given: `object_id` > `export_id` > `share_url`.
- Requests with invalid parameters are still processed by WeChat and billed upstream.

## Pricing

Flat price per call. Failed calls, including lookups whose target does not exist, are not charged.
